Sample quota responses for the planquota parsers: hand-written reconstructions of the shapes handled by sub2api backend/internal/service/cn_provider_quota_service.go (LGPL-3.0): zhipu /api/monitor/usage/quota/limit, kimi coding /v1/usages, minimax coding_plan/remains. Field names follow that source, values are invented. The endpoints are not public contracts: verify against a real account.
